title: A Maintained Vehicle and the Rate the Host's Share Is Taken At
content:
A vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan and kept under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan carries less of an accepted loss, and how much less turns on whether the care plan still has included services to run.

- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan with included services still to run, the share is taken at the marketplace's maintained-vehicle rate of 90 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan whose included services are used up, it is taken at the marketplace's part-maintained rate of 95 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, it is taken at the whole of the figure the rates before it leave.

### The three readings side by side

| Care plan on the vehicle | Included services remaining | The share is taken at |
|---|---|---|
| Active | more than none | 90 percent |
| Active | none left | 95 percent |
| Not active, or none held | — | the whole of the figure |

A care plan that is held but not active is treated as no active care plan, and the figure is left whole.

### Records consulted

The standing of the care plan and the included services still remaining on it are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle.
